Form type Form D/A | Reg D 506(b) | Filed Nov 25, 2026 | Monroe Capital Opportunistic II Private Credit (Delaware) Feeder Fund LP and four sister vehicles, $296.0M sold to 95 investors | Jefferies LLC and Arbour Partners LLP listed

A group of five **Monroe Capital** private credit vehicles filed Form D amendments on Nov. 25, each reporting $296.0 million sold to 95 investors in an offering of indefinite size. The Delaware feeder lists **Jefferies LLC** and **Arbour Partners LLP** as brokers, the Luxembourg feeders list **ISP Financial Services Ltd.** and **Arbour Partners LLP**, and the funds claim Reg D 506(b) plus the Section 3(c)(7) fund exemption.

1. **Monroe Capital Opportunistic II Private Credit (Delaware) Feeder Fund LP**, two Luxembourg feeders, an Irish ICAV and the SICAV-RAIF master fund each show $296.0M sold to 95 investors under Reg D 506(b) 2. Private credit structure, indefinite offering size 3. Brokers **Jefferies LLC**, **Arbour Partners LLP** and **ISP Financial Services Ltd.** listed

p: Form type Form D/A | Reg D 506(b) | Filed Nov 25, 2026 | Monroe Capital Opportunistic II Private Credit (Delaware) Feeder Fund LP and four sister vehicles, $296.0M sold to 95 investors | Jefferies LLC and Arbour Partners LLP listed

5개의 **Monroe Capital** 사모대출 펀드 및 자매 펀드로 구성된 그룹이 11월 25일 Form D 수정 서류를 제출했으며, 각각 무기한 규모의 공모를 통해 95명의 투자자에게 2억9,600만 달러가 판매되었다고 보고했다. 델라웨어 피더펀드는 **Jefferies LLC**와 **Arbour Partners LLP**를 브로커로 기재했고, 룩셈부르크 피더펀드들은 **ISP Financial Services Ltd.**와 **Arbour Partners LLP**를 기재했으며, 해당 펀드들은 Reg D 506(b) 및 섹션 3(c)(7) 펀드 면제를 적용받는다고 신고했다.

1. **Monroe Capital Opportunistic II Private Credit (Delaware) Feeder Fund LP**, 2개의 룩셈부르크 피더펀드, 아일랜드 ICAV 및 SICAV-RAIF 마스터 펀드 각각 Reg D 506(b)에 따라 95명의 투자자에게 2억9,600만 달러가 판매된 것으로 나타남 2. 사모대출 구조, 무기한 공모 규모 3. 브로커로 **Jefferies LLC**, **Arbour Partners LLP**, **ISP Financial Services Ltd.**가 기재됨
